information.description:
Jonins are information brokers and datafort defenders. They aren’t the most skilled ‘runners out there and are weak in a direct fight, but they’re invaluable to the Tyger’s efforts to ensure that they know about everything going on in their territory.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).

description.value: Master hackers who put themselves at risk as they jack into cyberspace to download secrets and infiltrate networks.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The A-22B Chao is their answer to Arasaka's Yukimura. As the gossip goes, both guns may have been designed by the same engineer, extracted from the Japanese corp on Kang Tao's orders. Whatever the case may be, you can be sure the Chao is easy to use and reload; once the last cartridge is used, the empty mag is auto-ejected.
